title: What changes when moving an office
excerpt: An office move has to protect business continuity as carefully as furniture, with clear ownership for equipment, access and the first working day.

paragraphs.text: Identify the teams, systems and records that must be available first. The move sequence should reflect how the business needs to reopen, not simply the order of rooms in the old workplace.
Use a consistent floor, zone and desk reference across labels and the new layout. Assign responsibility for sensitive equipment and confirm which items require specialist preparation.
Test access, connectivity and essential shared spaces before teams arrive. Keep a small response group available to resolve placement questions without interrupting the wider business.
A concise handover record helps facilities, IT and department leads confirm that priority areas are ready.
